```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## default aniopts="controls,loop" and explained here: https://www.w3schools.com/tags/tag_video.asp
## Disable the 'loop' option.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.width=6,fig.height=6,echo=FALSE,aniopts="controls")
library(mussel)
library(gridConstruct)
data(grid, package="mussel") ## Get default grid
load("env.RData")
animYears <- 2006:latestYear
## From stockassessment.org
xtab <- function(tab,...) {
  rownames(tab) <- paste0("**",rownames(tab),"**")
  dec <- c(2,2,2,0,0,0,2)
  tab <- t(round(t(tab),dec))
  knitr::kable(tab,...)
}
xanim <- function(area) {
  k <- which(as.logical(env$regionIndicator[, area]))
  for(i in animYears) plotBiomassMap(env, time=i, xlim=range(gr$lon[k]), ylim=range(gr$lat[k]))
}
```

# By area

## Natura Loegstoer

```{r}
tab1 <- plotTimeSeries(env,"Natura Loegstoer")
```

```{r, results='asis'}
xtab(tab1, caption="Natura Loegstoer")
```

```{r, fig.show='animate'}
xanim("Natura Loegstoer")
```

# Prodomr table

```{r, results='asis'}
nm <- colnames(env$regionIndicator)
lst <- lapply(nm, function(x) plotTimeSeries(env,x, doplot=FALSE)[latestYear,,drop=FALSE] )
tab1 <- do.call("rbind",lst)
rownames(tab1) <- nm
xtab(tab1, caption=latestYear)
```
